en.topic_title: Hong Kong man found guilty of murdering yoga instructor ex-girlfriend in luxury hotel room
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong man has been found guilty of murdering his ex-girlfriend, more than four years after she was found dead in a bathtub in a luxury hotel room.



High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Alex Lo, 32, was convicted at the High Court on Thursday, the 14th day of his trial, after the seven-member jury – comprising five men and two women – arrived at the unanimous verdict.
